paragraphs: Link to QR is a premium, high-performance QR code generator designed for professionals. Built with React and Tailwind CSS v4, it offers a sleek, distraction-free interface with deep customization options. Whether you need a simple black-and-white QR code or a branded design with custom colors and logos, this tool delivers production-ready assets in seconds.
features: 🎨 Professional UI/UX: A clean Slate/Zinc design system that feels right at home in enterprise environments.
🌗 Smart Theming: Fully supported Light, Dark, and System modes with seamless transitions.
⚡ Click-to-Generate: Optimized performance logic that generates QR codes only when you're ready, preventing lag.
Dots & Corners: Choose from multiple styles (Square, Rounded, Extra-Rounded, Classy).
